dim_when_paused_help: After the player has been paused this long, the screen dims, then turns off when your phone's own screen timeout allows. Tap to bring it back; the video stays paused where it was.
download_notifications_footer: Tells you when downloads finish or fail. VibeyFin asks for permission the first time a download starts; if you declined, allow notifications in system settings.
download_over_mobile_help: Off: downloads wait for Wi-Fi. Applies to this profile.
downloads_empty_help: Download a movie or an episode to watch it without a connection.
load_download_forbidden: This account isn't allowed to download. Ask the server's admin to turn downloads on for it.
load_download_interrupted: The download failed. Remove it and try again.
load_download_no_file: This has no file to download.
load_download_no_space: There isn't enough space on this device. Remove a download or free some space, then try again.
load_download_not_on_server: This is no longer on the server, so it can't be downloaded.
load_download_sign_in: Sign in again to go on with this download.
load_download_storage_limit: This would go over your storage limit for downloads. Remove a download or raise the limit in Settings.
load_download_unplayable: This video is in a format this device can't play, so it can't be downloaded here.
load_not_downloaded: This isn't downloaded, so it can't open without a connection.
offline_mode_help: Use only your downloads, even when you're online.
offline_mode_toast: Offline mode is on. Showing what you've downloaded.
offline_search_empty: Nothing you've downloaded matches. Try another word.
offline_toast: You're offline. Showing what you've downloaded.
player_screen_dimmed: Screen dimmed. Tap to wake it.
purge_downloads_confirm_message: The downloads of this profile are deleted from this device. Other profiles keep theirs. You can download again at any time.
purge_downloads_help: Removes every download of this profile and any leftover files, also those shown in the Files app.
storage_limit_help: New downloads wait when the limit is reached. Applies to this profile.
